thesis.title: One file, from thesis to signing.
thesis.intro: Strategy, analysis, valuation, capital structure, negotiation and close sit in the same file. Split them and the deal stalls.
thesis.principle: A file comes in if the thesis, the structure, the capital and a path to close all hold. The rest waits or drops.

about.title: Founding partners, one structure.
about.subtitle: More than 75 years of combined practice. The figures are track record, not group AUM.
about.body: NAHU Capital is a Mexican company with a Franco-Mexican reading of the work. Corporate finance, audit, banking, M&A and real assets: mining, energy, infrastructure, industry, real estate. The file is worked as a whole.
about.differential: What thesis holds it, what structure makes it viable, what capital comes in, what risk remains, and on what terms it can sign.

team.title: Who runs the file.
team.body: Four partners. Each one comes in on the work that holds the deal.
team.note: Published amounts refer to the founding partners’ track record.

people.name: Juan Balbontin
people.bio: Works with investors, developers and operators in Mexico. Commercial and real-estate development inside large groups. Economics, University of Georgia.

people.name: Ana María Almeida Luján
people.bio: Capital structure, due diligence and real-asset reading: mining, industry, energy, real estate. Banks, funds, family offices. Chairs the financial-services section of CANACO Chihuahua.

people.name: Patrick Diogo
people.bio: Corporate finance, audit and transactions, including cross-border oil and gas. Economics, University of Lyon; specialized master’s in finance, emlyon. French, English, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian.

people.name: Gregory Prudhommeaux
people.bio: Europe, Asia, the Americas. Seventeen years in China; Mexico since 2023. International origination, JVs and fundraising. Conseiller du Commerce Extérieur de la France; CCI France México in Jalisco. French, English, Spanish and Mandarin.

portfolio.model: NAHU Capital connects capital, companies, assets and markets from a Mexican company. The job is to put together work that can close, using vehicles allowed by its corporate purpose and the rules that apply.
